title: natural-order rename with a mistyped +++ is E209 in the rename block
notes: §12 item 1: §4.1 HEADER, a pair after a completed from/to pair belongs to the rename header when its `---` path equals `from` ('a `+++` path that differs from `to` is then E209, so a typo in `+++` is reported precisely'). '--- a.txt' equals 'rename from a.txt', so the document is one block and '+++ c.txt' vs 'rename to b.txt' is E209 (§6.3.2 check 3).
